observations.why: Present-progressive framing of a planned migration names concrete artifacts; the switch is announced as underway but not yet settled, suspending realis.
Bare comparative claims presented as current-state properties of the target system; performance and cost are abstract categories asserted as actual.
Arrow notation denotes a planned transition between two named concrete systems; the migration is projected, not yet realized.
Projected performance gain stated as a target metric; analytical query performance is an abstract category framed as a future outcome.
Named calendar quarter anchors a concrete future timeline for the planned migration.
